title: Counting Dogs
statement_md:
A kennel keeps a log of arrivals. Given a list of dog counts `nums` and a target total `target`, return the indices of the two entries that sum to the target.

Return the indices in ascending order.
constraints_md:
- `2 <= nums.length <= 10^4`
- `-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
- exactly one valid answer exists
hint_md: What have you already seen? A dictionary answers that in O(1).
import_notes: You did not say what happens when several pairs sum to the target, so I assumed exactly one valid pair exists, matching the examples you gave.
